questions.q_en: How many parts did you put on the Registry, and how are they organised?
questions.q_zh: 你們在 Registry 上放了幾個 parts？怎麼組織的？
questions.a_en: Forty-one, in four assembly levels. Twelve basic parts, twelve transcriptional units, thirteen cassettes and four whole four-unit systems, built on fourteen parts from earlier teams. Our wiki presents thirty-five of the forty-one, because four were withheld and the last corrected re-deposits landed after that page was written. If you are counting from the Registry you will get forty-one, and that is the number I would use.
questions.a_zh: 四十一個，分成四個組裝層級。十二個基本元件、十二個轉錄單元、十三個表現卡匣，以及四個完整的四單元系統，建立在十四個過去隊伍的 parts 上。我們的 wiki 介紹其中三十五個，因為有四個保留，而最後幾筆修正後的重新上傳是在那一頁寫完之後才上去的。如果你是從 Registry 數，會得到四十一，那也是我會用的數字。
questions.trap_en: Saying thirty-five because that is the number on the wiki, when the judge is looking at the Registry listing.
questions.trap_zh: 因為 wiki 上寫三十五就說三十五，而評審看的是 Registry 的清單。
questions.basis: the first thing a judge checks against the organisation page

questions.q_en: Which of your parts are you proudest of, and why that one?
questions.q_zh: 你們最得意的是哪一個 part？為什麼是它？
questions.a_en: PcpcG2-veg, 177 base pairs, the smallest thing we deposited. It exists because we caught a mistake: our first green-light cassettes carried a 1045 bp third-party part that includes an sfGFP dropout cassette where the promoter should be. We isolated the promoter, deposited it ourselves, and re-deposited four corrected constructs around it. A part that exists because of a failure is worth more to the next team than a part that happened to work.
questions.a_zh: PcpcG2-veg，177 個鹼基對，是我們上傳過最小的東西。它存在的原因是我們抓到一個錯誤：最早的綠光卡匣在啟動子的位置上帶著一個 1045 bp 的第三方 part，裡面包含 sfGFP dropout 卡匣。我們把啟動子單獨切出來、自己上傳，再用它重新上傳四個修正後的構築。一個因為失敗而存在的 part，對下一隊的價值高於一個剛好能用的 part。
questions.trap_en: Naming the Level 2 system because it is the biggest. It is also the one still carrying the uncorrected deposit.
questions.trap_zh: 因為最大就說 Level 2 系統。那正好也是還帶著未修正版本的那一個。
questions.basis: standard opener; the answer decides whether the next ten minutes are yours

questions.q_en: Two of your parts have exactly the same title. Did you upload the same thing twice?
questions.q_zh: 你們有兩個 parts 標題一模一樣。是同一個東西上傳了兩次嗎？
kw_en: kept both, gels ran on the old
kw_zh: 兩個都留，膠跑的是舊的
questions.a_en: No. They are different sequences, 868 base pairs apart. The first carries a third-party promoter part that includes an sfGFP dropout cassette; the second carries the 177 bp promoter we deposited ourselves. Four pairs do this. We kept both of each because our gels were run on the first one, so deleting it would orphan the evidence that is already published.
questions.a_zh: 不是。它們是不同的序列，差 868 個鹼基對。第一個帶著一個包含 sfGFP dropout 卡匣的第三方啟動子 part；第二個帶的是我們自己上傳的 177 bp 啟動子。像這樣的有四對。每一對我們都留著，因為膠是在第一個上面跑的，刪掉它會讓已經發表的證據變成孤兒。
questions.trap_en: Saying 'that was a mistake' and stopping. The second half, what you did about it, is the part that scores.
questions.trap_zh: 只說「那是個錯誤」就停住。真正得分的是後半段：你們為此做了什麼。
questions.basis: visible from the organisation listing without opening anything

questions.q_en: Five of your published parts have no documentation at all. Why those five?
questions.q_zh: 你們有五個已發布的 parts 完全沒有文件。為什麼是那五個？
questions.a_en: No good reason, and the empty ones are not the unimportant ones. EEBD-RBS0 sits inside thirteen of our constructs and is the constant that makes the Csn against SamyQ comparison fair. PcpcG2-veg is the promoter we deposited to fix the sfGFP problem, and its page says only 'light induced promoter'. Those are the two I would write first and I can tell you now what each would say.
questions.a_zh: 沒有好理由，而且空白的那幾個不是不重要的。EEBD-RBS0 在我們十三個構築裡面，是讓 Csn 和 SamyQ 能公平比較的那個常數。PcpcG2-veg 是我們為了修正 sfGFP 問題而上傳的啟動子，而它的頁面只寫了「light induced promoter」。那兩個我會最先補，而且我現在就可以告訴你每一頁會寫什麼。
questions.trap_en: Promising to write them later. Say which two matter and what they would contain, in the room.
questions.trap_zh: 承諾以後再補。要在現場說出哪兩個最重要，以及它們會寫什麼。
questions.basis: one click from the organisation listing

questions.q_en: Walk me up your assembly levels. What is the difference between a Level 1 cassette and a Level 2 system?
questions.q_zh: 帶我走一遍你們的組裝層級。Level 1 卡匣和 Level 2 系統差在哪裡？
kw_en: L0 basic, L1 unit, L2 cassette
kw_zh: L0 基本、L1 單元、L2 卡匣
questions.a_en: A Level 0 part is one element: a promoter, an RBS or a coding sequence. A Level 1 part fuses a signal peptide to a cargo, or puts a promoter in front of one gene. A Level 2 cassette is promoter, RBS, fusion and terminator on one transformable plasmid, assembled with BsaI. The whole system puts four of those transcriptional units on a single plasmid with BsmBI: the chromophore module, the sensor, the response regulator and the output.
questions.a_zh: Level 0 是單一元件：一個啟動子、一個 RBS 或一段編碼序列。Level 1 把訊號肽接到 cargo 上，或把一個啟動子放到一個基因前面。Level 2 卡匣是啟動子、RBS、融合和終止子組在一個可轉形的質體上，用 BsaI 組裝。完整系統再用 BsmBI 把四個這樣的轉錄單元放到同一個質體上：色素基團模組、感測器、反應調節子，以及輸出。
questions.trap_en: Describing the biology instead of the assembly. The question is about how the parts nest.
questions.trap_zh: 講生物學而不是組裝。這題問的是 parts 怎麼層層包起來。
questions.basis: the structure question that sets up everything after it

questions.q_en: Fourteen of the parts in your constructs are not yours. What did you actually add?
questions.q_zh: 你們構築裡有十四個 parts 不是你們的。那你們到底加了什麼？
kw_en: we added the fusions and cassettes
kw_zh: CcaSR 和 Pveg 是借的
我們加的是融合與卡匣
questions.a_en: The light-sensing machinery is borrowed: CcaS, CcaR, the Ho1-pcyA fusion, Pveg, PliaG, the terminators. What we added is everything between a secretion signal and a plant: eight signal-peptide fusions, thirteen cassettes, four whole systems, our own PcpcG2-veg deposit, and codon-recoded versions of three cargoes. Nobody had put a plant protectant behind a green-light switch in Bacillus subtilis and deposited the whole chain.
questions.a_zh: 光感測的機制是借的：CcaS、CcaR、Ho1-pcyA 融合、Pveg、PliaG、終止子。我們加的是從分泌訊號到植物之間的一切：八個訊號肽融合、十三個卡匣、四個完整系統、我們自己的 PcpcG2-veg，以及三個 cargo 的密碼子重編碼版本。在枯草桿菌裡把植物保護蛋白放在綠光開關後面、並且把整條鏈上傳，這是沒有人做過的。
questions.trap_en: Listing what you built without naming what was borrowed. A judge who has read the composition already knows.
questions.trap_zh: 只列你們做了什麼，卻不說哪些是借的。讀過組成的評審早就知道了。
questions.basis: positioning question; the composition tab makes it unavoidable

questions.q_zh: 你們的 part 文件是誰寫的？
questions.a_en: I did, all forty-one pages, mostly across the seventeenth and eighteenth of October. That is in the Registry's own edit record so there is no point saying otherwise, and it is also the honest answer to why five pages are empty. The science on them is the whole team's; the writing was two days and one person.
questions.a_zh: 我寫的，四十一頁全部，主要集中在十月十七和十八日。這在 Registry 自己的編輯紀錄上就看得到，沒有必要講別的；這也誠實地回答了為什麼有五頁是空的。頁面上的科學是整個團隊的，但寫作是兩天、一個人。
questions.trap_en: Spreading the credit vaguely. The record is public and checking it takes one click.
questions.trap_zh: 含糊地把功勞分給大家。紀錄是公開的，點一下就查得到。
questions.basis: asked when a collection looks uneven

questions.q_en: If another team wanted to build on your work tomorrow, which part would you tell them to take?
questions.q_zh: 如果別的隊伍明天想接著你們做，你會叫他們拿哪一個 part？
questions.a_en: The CDS-replaceable cassette, with mScarlet-I in the slot. It lets you swap your own cargo into our green-light system without rebuilding the circuit, and the reporter is there so you can see the swap worked before you commit anything expensive. I should say the page is Design only at the moment, so what I have just described is a claim rather than a demonstration.
questions.a_zh: 可換 CDS 的卡匣，槽位上放著 mScarlet-I。它讓你把自己的 cargo 換進我們的綠光系統，不用重建線路，而報導基因放在那裡，是讓你在投入昂貴的東西之前先確認換得起來。我得說，它的頁面目前只有 Design，所以我剛剛描述的是一個主張，不是一次展示。
questions.trap_en: Over-selling it. The last sentence is what keeps the rest credible.
questions.trap_zh: 講得太滿。最後那一句才是讓前面可信的東西。
questions.basis: the contribution question, asked through the parts

questions.q_en: Your cassette page says the insert is 906 base pairs. The deposited sequence is 712. Which is right?
questions.q_zh: 你們卡匣頁面寫插入片段是 906 個鹼基對，上傳的序列是 712。哪個對？
questions.a_en: The sequence. The stated number is wrong and it is wrong the same way on seven of our cassettes: the promoter length we carried into the insert arithmetic was about 290 base pairs, and Pveg is 97. You can see it without arithmetic on three of them, because three architecturally identical cassettes are all 712 bp and state 910, 906 and 906. The gels are not affected; those band sizes match our wiki captions.
questions.a_zh: 序列。寫下來的數字是錯的，而且在我們七個卡匣上錯法一樣：帶進插入長度計算的啟動子長度大約是 290 個鹼基對，而 Pveg 是 97。其中三個根本不用算就看得出來，因為三個結構完全相同的卡匣都是 712 bp，卻分別寫了 910、906、906。膠沒有受影響，那些帶大小和我們 wiki 上的圖說一致。
questions.trap_en: Defending the stated number. It cannot be right; the sequence is on the same page.
questions.trap_zh: 替寫下來的數字辯護。它不可能對，序列就在同一頁上。
questions.basis: arithmetic a judge can do from the Sequence tab

questions.q_en: This page says the expected band is 1145 base pairs, and the caption underneath says 7767. Same gel.
questions.q_zh: 這一頁說期望帶是 1145 個鹼基對，下面的圖說寫 7767。同一張膠。
kw_zh: 1145 是另一個 part 的數字
questions.a_en: That is a mistake on a live page and it is ours. Neither number is right. Working from the deposited sequence and the two primers the page names, the product is 1195 base pairs. The 1145 figure belongs to a different part's gel caption, and 7767 is plasmid scale and cannot be this amplicon. The gel itself is fine: one colony, one band, sequence-verified afterwards.
questions.a_zh: 那是線上頁面上的錯誤，是我們的錯。兩個數字都不對。用上傳的序列和頁面寫的那兩支引子算，產物是 1195 個鹼基對。1145 是另一個 part 的膠說明上的數字，7767 是質體等級，不可能是這個產物。膠本身沒有問題：一個菌落、一條帶，之後有定序確認。
questions.trap_en: Picking one of the two printed numbers to defend. Compute the third and say so.
questions.trap_zh: 從印出來的兩個數字裡挑一個來辯護。要算出第三個並且說出來。
questions.basis: a page that contradicts itself eight lines apart

questions.q_en: Two of your parts state the same insert length, 1122 base pairs, but they carry different signal peptides. How can both be right?
questions.q_zh: 你們兩個 parts 寫了同樣的插入長度 1122 個鹼基對，但它們帶的是不同的訊號肽。怎麼可能兩個都對？
questions.a_en: They cannot both be right. SamyQ is 93 base pairs and Csn is 108, so the two fusions differ by fifteen even with the same cargo and the same tag. The number is correct for the SamyQ fusion. The Csn one should read 1137 and it was copied across. It is the same copy-paste event that put a wrong cross-reference on a sibling page, so I treat the two as one error.
questions.a_zh: 兩個不可能都對。SamyQ 是 93 個鹼基對，Csn 是 108，所以即使 cargo 和標籤相同，兩個融合也差十五。那個數字對 SamyQ 的融合是對的。Csn 那個應該是 1137，是被複製過去的。這和把錯誤交叉連結貼到姊妹頁面上的是同一次複製貼上，所以我把兩者當成同一個錯誤。
questions.trap_en: Not knowing the two signal peptide lengths. Fifteen base pairs is the whole answer.
questions.trap_zh: 不知道兩個訊號肽的長度。十五個鹼基對就是整個答案。
questions.basis: two sibling tabs open side by side

questions.q_en: I pulled the sequence of this cassette. There is an sfGFP coding sequence in the middle of it. Why?
questions.q_zh: 我把這個卡匣的序列拉出來看，中間有一段 sfGFP 編碼序列。為什麼？
questions.a_en: Because that deposit is the pre-assembly map, not the finished construct. The SubtiToolKit vectors carry an sfGFP dropout between Type IIS sites, so a white colony means the insert replaced it. What we deposited there still shows the dropout, and worse, it puts a terminator between the promoter and the ribosome binding site. Editing text cannot fix that, so we deposited the promoter on its own and re-deposited the corrected construct.
questions.a_zh: 因為那一筆上傳的是組裝前的圖譜，不是完成的構築。SubtiToolKit 載體在 Type IIS 位點之間帶著 sfGFP dropout，所以白色菌落代表插入片段把它換掉了。我們上傳的那一筆上面還留著 dropout，更糟的是，它把一個終止子放在啟動子和核醣體結合位之間。這不是改文字能修的，所以我們把啟動子單獨上傳，再重新上傳修正後的構築。
questions.trap_en: Calling it a naming convention. The suffix on the vector name is; 868 bases inside the deposited sequence are not.
questions.trap_zh: 說那是命名慣例。載體名稱上的後綴是，但上傳序列裡面那 868 個鹼基不是。
questions.basis: the worst thing in the collection, and visible to anyone who opens the sequence

questions.q_en: This is registered as a coding sequence and it has neither a start nor a stop codon. Explain.
questions.q_zh: 這個登記成編碼序列，卻沒有起始也沒有終止密碼子。解釋一下。
kw_en: start lives in the signal peptide
kw_zh: 終止在 His 標籤後
questions.a_en: Deliberately. The native start and stop were removed so the cargo can be fused behind a signal peptide and in front of a His tag: the start codon lives in SamyQ or Csn and the stop sits after the tag. All eight of our cargo parts are like that. We explain it in a draft that is not published, which is why the live page does not say it, and that is a fair thing to catch us on.
questions.a_zh: 這是刻意的。原生的起始與終止被拿掉，好讓 cargo 可以接在訊號肽後面、His 標籤前面：起始密碼子在 SamyQ 或 Csn 裡，終止密碼子在標籤之後。我們八個 cargo parts 都是這樣。我們在一份還沒發布的草稿裡有說明，所以線上頁面上看不到，這一點被抓到是合理的。
questions.trap_en: Treating it as an error. It is correct for a fusion library and the page simply fails to say so.
questions.trap_zh: 把它當成錯誤。對一個融合元件庫來說這是正確的，只是頁面沒有寫出來。
questions.basis: a role-versus-sequence mismatch any curator notices

questions.q_en: SamyQ is a registered part on your pages. Csn is not. Where is Csn?
questions.q_zh: SamyQ 在你們頁面上是一個註冊的 part，Csn 不是。Csn 在哪裡？
kw_zh: 應該自己成為一個 part
questions.a_en: Only inside the fusions. SamyQ is cited properly as an earlier team's part, and the chitosanase signal is not registered anywhere, so a judge clicking for it finds nothing. Worse, our two Csn fusions imply different lengths for it, 108 bases in one and 111 in the other, because one carries an extra upstream ATG. If I deposit one more part it is Csn, with that discrepancy resolved.
questions.a_zh: 只存在於融合裡面。SamyQ 有好好引用成過去隊伍的 part，而 chitosanase 訊號肽沒有在任何地方註冊，所以評審想點進去會找不到。更糟的是，我們兩個 Csn 融合暗示它有不同長度，一個 108 個鹼基、另一個 111，因為其中一個多了一個上游的 ATG。如果我再上傳一個 part，那就是 Csn，並且把這個差異解決掉。
questions.trap_en: Saying it is in the fusion and leaving it there. The two different lengths are the real finding.
questions.trap_zh: 只說「它在融合裡」就結束。兩個不同長度才是真正的發現。
questions.basis: a dead end a judge hits while comparing the two signal peptides

questions.q_en: One of your Csn fusions starts ATG-ATG. Why are there two start codons?
questions.q_zh: 你們其中一個 Csn 融合是 ATG-ATG 開頭。為什麼有兩個起始密碼子？
kw_en: the AcdS sibling does not have it
questions.a_en: There is an extra upstream ATG on the LEA14 fusion that the AcdS fusion does not carry, which is why that part is 582 base pairs rather than 579 and why its Csn segment runs from position four. I cannot tell you from the Registry whether that was designed in or came in with the synthesis order. It is a three-base difference that would shift a reading frame if anything downstream depended on it, and nothing does, but it should be documented.
questions.a_zh: LEA14 的融合上多了一個上游的 ATG，而 AcdS 的融合沒有，這就是為什麼那個 part 是 582 個鹼基對而不是 579，也是為什麼它的 Csn 片段從第四位開始。光看 Registry 我沒辦法告訴你那是設計進去的，還是隨著合成訂單進來的。那是三個鹼基的差異，如果下游有東西依賴它就會移碼，而目前沒有，但這應該被記錄下來。
questions.trap_en: Claiming it is a Kozak-like element. Bacillus does not use one and the page says nothing.
questions.trap_zh: 說那是類似 Kozak 的元件。枯草桿菌沒有這種東西，而頁面上什麼都沒寫。
questions.basis: base-by-base comparison of two sibling fusions

questions.q_en: How do you know your Level 2 assembly is actually correct?
questions.q_zh: 你們怎麼知道 Level 2 的組裝真的是對的？
questions.a_en: At the junctions, not end to end. We screened every module boundary rather than one, because one module being right does not verify the others: the cross-module products come out at 632, 375 and 441 base pairs and we got all three in three separate clones. That says the four units are joined in the right order. It says nothing about the sequence between the junctions, and no Level 2 construct of ours has been sequenced end to end.
questions.a_zh: 在接點上，不是端到端。我們篩的是每一個模組的邊界，而不是只篩一個，因為一個模組對不代表其他也對：跨模組的產物落在 632、375 和 441 個鹼基對，三個獨立的 clone 我們三個都拿到了。這說明四個單元接的順序是對的，但它沒有說接點之間的序列是對的，而我們沒有任何一個 Level 2 構築做過端到端定序。
questions.trap_en: Saying 'it was sequenced'. The build record's Level 2 sequencing cell is empty and the page says so.
questions.trap_zh: 說「有定序」。組裝紀錄裡 Level 2 的定序欄是空的，頁面上也寫了。
questions.basis: the obvious follow-up to any assembly claim

questions.q_en: If I gave you an hour before this session, what would you fix on the Registry first?
questions.q_zh: 如果在這場會談前給你一小時，你會先修 Registry 上的什麼？
kw_zh: 貼錯 part 的那一段
再來是 EEBD-RBS0 的頁面
questions.a_en: Three things in order. Delete the paragraph on our chromophore module that describes cloning a completely different construct, because it is plainly wrong and deletion needs no new data. Fix the page that states two different expected band sizes for the same gel. Then write EEBD-RBS0's page, because it sits in thirteen constructs and is currently blank. The band sizes across the seven Pveg cassettes need recomputing too, and that is more than an hour.
questions.a_zh: 三件事，照順序。刪掉色素基團模組上那一段描述完全不同構築選殖過程的文字，因為它明顯是錯的，而刪除不需要新資料。修掉那一頁對同一張膠寫了兩個期望帶大小的問題。接著寫 EEBD-RBS0 的頁面，因為它在十三個構築裡，現在卻是空白。七個 Pveg 卡匣的帶大小也要重算，而那超過一小時。
questions.trap_en: Answering with a wish list. Name three, in order, with a reason each, and admit what will not fit.
questions.trap_zh: 用一串願望清單回答。要說出三件、排好順序、各給一個理由，並承認什麼做不完。
questions.basis: asked to see whether you know your own weak points by rank
